name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-10-06, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
